Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists Chevron Oil, plant 2047, generator 5, as operating. It is a gas turbine of 101.3 MW that started in May 1994. No retirement date is listed.

Capacity (MW).note: The same EIA table gives a nameplate of 101.3 MW. GEM shows 101.0, so this is only a rounding difference. Change it only if you want the table's figure.

units.notes: Still operating in the EIA table for September 2026. I found no retirement or mothballing notice.

Captive industry use.note: The Southern Company annual report for 2024 at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/92122/000009212225000018/so-20241231.htm says Mississippi Power provides retail service to the Chevron refinery in Pascagoula through at least 2038. It says Mississippi Power owns co-generation assets at the refinery, and that the contract refers to steam output at that facility. It does not name the 101 MW turbine alone, so the match to this unit is implied.
